metadata.title: Heat Transfer Equation Reference
metadata.scope_note: Curated equation reference only. Catalog inclusion does not imply calculator or end-to-end verification support.
metadata.conventions: SI units unless stated otherwise; absolute temperature is required in radiation equations. Empirical correlations include their validity assumptions.

nist_radiation.title: Fire Dynamics Simulator Technical Reference Guide, Volume 5: Mathematical Model
authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology

heat_rate_energy_balance.name: Control-volume heat balance
assumptions: All heat rates use a consistent sign convention

sensible_heat_rate_stream.name: Sensible heat carried by a stream
assumptions: Negligible kinetic and potential energy changes
Constant cp over the temperature interval

fourier_law.name: Fourier law of conduction
assumptions: k is the conductivity in the direction of the temperature gradient

newton_cooling.name: Newton law of cooling
assumptions: h represents the specified surface and flow condition
Ts and Tinf are representative temperatures

stefan_boltzmann_net_large_surroundings.name: Gray surface radiation to large surroundings
assumptions: View factor from surface to surroundings is approximately one

general_heat_conduction_equation.name: General heat conduction equation
general_heat_conduction_equation.equation: rho * cp * dT/dt = div(k * grad(T)) + qdot_gen'''
assumptions: cp and k may vary spatially or with temperature

cylindrical_radial_heat_equation.name: Cylindrical radial transient heat equation
assumptions: No axial or circumferential temperature gradients

series_thermal_resistances.name: Series thermal resistance network
assumptions: No heat generation between network nodes

contact_resistance.name: Thermal contact resistance
assumptions: Interface conductance hc is known and uniform

convection_resistance.name: Convection thermal resistance
assumptions: Specified area and representative convection coefficient

radiation_linearized_coefficient.name: Linearized radiation heat-transfer coefficient
assumptions: Gray surface facing large isothermal surroundings
Equivalent coefficient is evaluated for the stated temperature pair

critical_radius_cylinder.name: Critical insulation radius for a cylinder
assumptions: Constant insulation conductivity and external h
Negligible radiation unless included in h

critical_radius_sphere.name: Critical insulation radius for a sphere
assumptions: Constant insulation conductivity and external h
Negligible radiation unless included in h

overall_heat_transfer_coefficient.name: Overall heat-transfer coefficient definition
assumptions: A_ref is the area basis used to define U
Thermal resistances are represented consistently on that area basis

thermal_diffusivity.name: Thermal diffusivity
assumptions: Properties evaluated at a representative temperature

biot_number.name: Biot number
assumptions: Lc = solid volume divided by exposed area

fourier_number.name: Fourier number
assumptions: Lc is the characteristic conduction length used by the solution

lumped_transient_temperature.name: Lumped-capacity transient temperature
assumptions: Bi is sufficiently small for negligible internal gradients

semi_infinite_step_temperature.name: Semi-infinite solid with a prescribed surface-temperature step
assumptions: Surface temperature changes instantaneously to constant Ts

slab_eigenvalue.name: Plane-wall transient eigenvalue equation
assumptions: Plane wall cooled symmetrically by convection on both faces

slab_center_one_term.name: Plane-wall center temperature, one-term solution
assumptions: One-term approximation is adequate at the time of interest

cylinder_eigenvalue.name: Infinite-cylinder transient eigenvalue equation
assumptions: Radial transient conduction in a long cylinder
Convective boundary at the cylinder surface
J0 and J1 are Bessel functions of the first kind

sphere_eigenvalue.name: Sphere transient eigenvalue equation
assumptions: Radial transient conduction in a sphere
Convective boundary at the sphere surface

fin_governing_equation.name: Straight-fin temperature equation
assumptions: Constant k, h, perimeter, and cross-sectional area

infinite_fin_heat_rate.name: Infinite-fin heat rate
assumptions: Straight fin of effectively infinite length

adiabatic_tip_fin_heat_rate.name: Finite straight fin heat rate with insulated tip

corrected_fin_length.name: Corrected length for a convective fin tip
assumptions: Straight fin with a small convective tip
Correction approximates tip heat loss by added lateral area

fin_effectiveness.name: Fin effectiveness
assumptions: Ab is the base area occupied by the fin
Reference heat transfer is convection from Ab without the fin

overall_surface_efficiency.name: Overall efficiency of a finned surface
assumptions: At = Af + exposed primary surface area
All fins have the same efficiency

convective_conduction_boundary.name: Convection boundary condition for a solid
assumptions: Normal points outward from the solid
Radiation and contact effects are absent or included separately

prescribed_flux_boundary.name: Prescribed surface heat-flux boundary condition
assumptions: Normal points outward from the solid
q''_s is positive outward under this sign convention

reynolds_number_heat_transfer.name: Reynolds number
assumptions: L is the geometry-specific characteristic length
Properties are evaluated at the correlation's prescribed temperature

prandtl_number.name: Prandtl number
assumptions: Fluid properties are evaluated consistently, commonly at film temperature

nusselt_number.name: Nusselt number
assumptions: L and h follow the selected geometry and correlation

grashof_number.name: Grashof number
assumptions: Fluid properties evaluated at a representative film temperature

rayleigh_number.name: Rayleigh number
assumptions: Natural-convection characteristic length and properties match the selected geometry correlation

stanton_number.name: Stanton number
assumptions: Forced convection with consistent characteristic length and properties

reynolds_heat_momentum_analogy.name: Reynolds heat-momentum analogy
assumptions: Pressure-gradient and property effects are small

colburn_j_factor.name: Colburn j-factor analogy
assumptions: Prandtl-number correction is suitable for the flow and property range

flat_plate_laminar_local_nusselt.name: Laminar flat-plate local Nusselt number
assumptions: Constant properties evaluated at film temperature

flat_plate_laminar_average_nusselt.name: Laminar flat-plate average Nusselt number
assumptions: Laminar boundary layer over the full length

flat_plate_turbulent_average_nusselt.name: Flat-plate average Nusselt number with leading-edge transition
assumptions: Turbulent correlation with laminar leading-edge correction

pipe_laminar_constant_wall_temperature.name: Fully developed laminar pipe flow, constant wall temperature
assumptions: Hydrodynamically and thermally fully developed laminar flow

pipe_laminar_constant_heat_flux.name: Fully developed laminar pipe flow, constant wall heat flux
assumptions: Hydrodynamically and thermally fully developed laminar flow

dittus_boelter.name: Dittus-Boelter turbulent-tube correlation
assumptions: Fully developed turbulent flow, typically Re_D >= 10000
Heating fluid: n=0.4; cooling fluid: n=0.3

sieder_tate.name: Sieder-Tate turbulent-tube correlation
assumptions: Bulk and wall viscosities are evaluated at their respective temperatures
Use within the source correlation's Reynolds and Prandtl ranges

gnielinski.name: Gnielinski turbulent-tube correlation
assumptions: f is the Darcy friction factor

laminar_hydrodynamic_entry_length.name: Laminar hydrodynamic entry length estimate
assumptions: Order-of-magnitude estimate for a uniform inlet profile

laminar_thermal_entry_length.name: Laminar thermal entry length estimate
assumptions: Order-of-magnitude estimate; use a developing-flow correlation when needed

churchill_bernstein_cylinder.name: Churchill-Bernstein crossflow over a cylinder
assumptions: Broad empirical range; property variation is modest

whitaker_sphere.name: Whitaker sphere forced-convection correlation
assumptions: Viscosity ratio accounts for surface-to-free-stream property change

churchill_chu_vertical_plate.name: Churchill-Chu vertical-plate natural convection
assumptions: Laminar-range form, commonly used for Ra_L up to about 1e9

churchill_chu_vertical_plate_full_range.name: Churchill-Chu vertical-plate natural convection, broad-range form

churchill_chu_horizontal_cylinder.name: Churchill-Chu horizontal-cylinder natural convection
assumptions: Isothermal horizontal cylinder in a large quiescent fluid

horizontal_plate_natural_convection_low_.name: Natural convection from an upward-facing heated horizontal plate, low Ra
assumptions: Hot horizontal surface facing upward, or cold surface facing downward

horizontal_plate_natural_convection_high.name: Natural convection from an upward-facing heated horizontal plate, high Ra
assumptions: Hot horizontal surface facing upward, or cold surface facing downward

heat_exchanger_capacity_rate.name: Heat-capacity rate of a flowing stream
assumptions: Constant cp over the exchanger temperature range

heat_exchanger_hot_stream_balance.name: Heat lost by the hot heat-exchanger stream

heat_exchanger_cold_stream_balance.name: Heat gained by the cold heat-exchanger stream

lmtd_heat_exchanger.name: Heat-exchanger LMTD rate equation
assumptions: F is the correction factor for the exchanger arrangement; F=1 for ideal parallel or counterflow

lmtd_parallel_flow.name: Parallel-flow log-mean temperature difference
assumptions: Both fluids enter at the same end
DeltaT1=Thi-Tci and DeltaT2=Tho-Tco, with positive terminal differences

lmtd_counterflow.name: Counterflow log-mean temperature difference
assumptions: DeltaT1=Thi-Tco and DeltaT2=Tho-Tci, with positive terminal differences

heat_exchanger_capacity_ratio.name: Heat-exchanger capacity-rate ratio
assumptions: Cmin and Cmax are the smaller and larger stream heat-capacity rates

number_transfer_units.name: Number of transfer units
assumptions: Overall U and area use the same reference surface
Cmin is the smaller stream heat-capacity rate

heat_exchanger_effectiveness.name: Heat-exchanger effectiveness
assumptions: Single hot and cold inlet streams

heat_exchanger_qmax.name: Maximum possible heat-exchanger rate
assumptions: Inlet temperatures define the maximum available temperature difference
One stream could ideally reach the other stream's inlet temperature

parallel_flow_effectiveness.name: Parallel-flow exchanger effectiveness
assumptions: Constant heat-capacity rates and overall U

counterflow_effectiveness.name: Counterflow exchanger effectiveness, unequal capacity rates
assumptions: Cr is not equal to one
Constant heat-capacity rates and overall U

counterflow_effectiveness_equal_capacity.name: Counterflow exchanger effectiveness, equal capacity rates
assumptions: Constant heat-capacity rates and overall U

overall_u_cylindrical_wall.name: Overall U for a cylindrical wall
assumptions: Steady radial heat transfer through a cylindrical wall
Inner and outer convection coefficients are uniform

overall_u_plane_wall.name: Overall U for a plane composite wall
assumptions: All terms use the same area basis

blackbody_spectral_emissive_power.name: Planck blackbody spectral emissive power
assumptions: Spectral quantity is per unit wavelength

spectral_to_total_emissive_power.name: Total emissive power from spectral emissive power
assumptions: Spectral emissive power is defined per unit wavelength

gray_surface_radiosity.name: Diffuse-gray surface radiosity
assumptions: Radiosity and irradiation are hemispherically integrated

net_radiation_surface_flux.name: Net radiative heat flux at a surface
assumptions: Positive flux is outward from the surface
J and G are total radiosity and irradiation

view_factor_summation.name: View-factor summation rule
assumptions: Enclosure is closed by all surfaces included in the sum
View factors use diffuse geometric exchange

view_factor_reciprocity.name: View-factor reciprocity relation
assumptions: Surfaces i and j exchange radiation in a nonparticipating medium

gray_parallel_plate_exchange.name: Radiation between large parallel gray plates
assumptions: View factor is one; temperatures are absolute

spectral_radiative_transfer_equation.name: Radiative transfer equation with absorption and scattering

kirchhoff_law.name: Kirchhoff law of thermal radiation
assumptions: Same wavelength and direction for emissivity and absorptivity

radiative_property_sum.name: Radiative property sum for an opaque surface
assumptions: Properties refer to the same spectral and directional conditions

nusselt_condensation_vertical_plate.name: Nusselt laminar film condensation on a vertical plate
assumptions: Laminar condensate film on an isothermal vertical plate
Negligible vapor shear and condensate subcooling
hfg_star = hfg + 0.68*cp_l*(Tsat-Tw) may account for condensate subcooling

nusselt_condensation_horizontal_tube.name: Nusselt laminar film condensation on a horizontal tube
assumptions: Laminar condensate film on a single horizontal tube
hfg_star is an effective latent heat when subcooling is included

rohsenow_pool_boiling.name: Rohsenow nucleate pool-boiling correlation
assumptions: Surface-fluid pair constants Csf and n are empirical
Saturated liquid properties at saturation temperature

zuber_critical_heat_flux.name: Zuber pool-boiling critical heat flux
assumptions: Saturated pool boiling near critical heat flux
Correlation is an idealized hydrodynamic estimate

latent_heat_phase_change.name: Latent heat rate for a phase change
assumptions: hfg is evaluated at the relevant saturation pressure or temperature

boiling_heat_transfer_coefficient.name: Boiling heat-transfer coefficient definition
assumptions: Heat flux and coefficient refer to the same surface area

condensation_heat_transfer_coefficient.name: Condensation heat-transfer coefficient definition
assumptions: Saturated vapor condenses on a cooler wall
Heat flux and coefficient use consistent area

latent_heat_enthalpy_balance.name: Condensation mass rate from heat removal
assumptions: Sensible cooling of condensate and vapor is negligible

radiation_enclosure_radiosity_network.name: Radiosity balance for an opaque diffuse-gray enclosure surface
assumptions: Enclosure contains all surfaces in the summation

radiation_exchange_from_radiosity.name: Radiative exchange from radiosity
assumptions: Positive rate denotes net radiation leaving surface i
